## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and relevant scope.

## Verification

List commands, results and anything unverified. Use the affected checks from
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#verification); explain when native/Test262
runs are unnecessary for documentation or tooling changes.

For semantics or conformance reporting changes, include baseline and post-change
pinned Test262 commands and exact outcomes. Keep fake-fixture and subset results
separate; focused runs do not establish full-suite conformance. Unsupported,
timeout, crash and bug outcomes are non-passing.

If fixtures or conformance inputs change, identify added/removed test-specific
materializations and link original failures and unresolved follow-ups.
